title: Make the next-phase decision
summary: Go, conditional go or no-go is a study recommendation, not production certification.

sections.label: Agree criteria first
sections.text: Domain/product and technical owners define usable behaviour, unacceptable errors, access constraints and the cost/time improvement justifying investment before interpreting results. This Atlas invents no percentages.

sections.label: Recommended decisions
rows: Initial evidence supports defined useful tasks, credible runtime/access, plausible economics and ownership; state limitations.
Name the unresolved assumption, owner, condition, experiment, effort and result reversing the decision.
Explain the hard constraint, unacceptable quality or weak economics; assess narrower assisted alternatives.

sections.label: Decision package
items: Evidence for examples, outcomes, observations and estimates.
Measured facts, assumptions, unknowns and their consequences.
Effort/cost, dependencies, owners and phased next scope.

sections.label: Different success measures
sections.text: Acceptance into Phase 2 planning is the ticket's planning outcome. Future feature success needs quality and user-value measures. A supported no-go can be a successful study.

sections.label: Source status
sections.text: GOV.UK discovery and NIST inform this framework; they are not binding company procedures. NIST's cited Core is AI RMF 1.0, with a revision in progress.

basis: Ticket-scoped recommendation; not an implemented workplace capability
confidence: Moderate for fit; workplace benefit unknown

catalog.applicability: Illustrative context. Compare its assumptions with your own work.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
